name: Republic RC-3 Seabee
summary: All-metal four-seat amphibian with a high wing and pusher engine mounted above and behind the cabin; built in 1946–47 and still popular with amphibian owners.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
engines: Single pusher engine mounted above and behind the cabin
fuselage: Egg-shaped cabin with a large windshield
Retractable tricycle gear into the hull

tellTales: Amphibian hull with a pusher engine above the cabin
Strut-braced high wing with tip floats
Egg-shaped cabin and a compact, single tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The Seabee has a lift strut each side and a lower engine tucked behind the cabin; the Lake has a strutless wing, a taller pylon-mounted engine and a T-tail.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
